pages.title: Shield Happens
pages.text: Develop your chosen fighting style and prepare for the next encounter.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Equip a shield in your offhand and hold use while facing a skeleton. Merely carrying a shield does not count.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Breacher breaks weak cover and disables a shield for four seconds; use its heavy-attack recovery instead of permanently blocking.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Identify local creepers before approaching: mushroom and desert variants need not share aggression or behavior. Not every variant is a vanilla creeper.
